Multiple axes

Source: vignettes/multiple-axes.Rmd
multiple-axes.Rmd

Price and carat across nine panels

Compare price (US dollars) against weight (carats) for three cuts and three colors in ggplot2::diamonds. Each panel shows a reproducible sample of 100 diamonds. All panels share the same axis limits.

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

set.seed(42)
groups <- ggplot2::diamonds |>
  filter(
    cut %in% c("Very Good", "Premium", "Ideal"),
    color %in% c("D", "E", "F")
  ) |>
  group_by(color, cut) |>
  slice_sample(n = 100)

keys <- group_keys(groups)
panels <- map(seq_len(nrow(keys)), function(i) {
  list(
    left = paste0(35 * ((i - 1) %% 3), "%"),
    top = paste0(35 * ((i - 1) %/% 3), "%"),
    width = "27%",
    height = "22%",
    offset = 0,
    startOnTick = FALSE,
    endOnTick = FALSE
  )
})
x_axes <- map2(panels, seq_along(panels), function(panel, i) {
  c(
    panel,
    list(
      min = 0,
      max = ceiling(max(groups$carat)),
      title = list(text = paste(keys$cut[i], "·", keys$color[i]))
    )
  )
})
y_axes <- map(panels, function(panel) {
  c(
    panel,
    list(
      min = 0,
      max = 20000,
      tickPositions = c(0, 10000, 20000),
      title = list(text = NULL)
    )
  )
})

chart <- highchart(height = 780) |>
  hc_title(text = "Diamond price by carat") |>
  hc_subtitle(
    text = "Columns show cut. Rows show color. Prices in US dollars."
  ) |>
  hc_chart(alignTicks = FALSE) |>
  hc_xAxis(x_axes) |>
  hc_yAxis(y_axes) |>
  hc_legend(enabled = FALSE)

reduce2(
  group_split(groups),
  seq_along(panels),
  function(hc, rows, i) {
    hc_add_series(
      hc,
      rows,
      "scatter",
      hcaes(x = carat, y = price),
      name = paste(keys$cut[i], keys$color[i]),
      xAxis = i - 1L,
      yAxis = i - 1L,
      marker = list(radius = 2)
    )
  },
  .init = chart
)
